title: test(plugin-auth): the last three #23184 test-budget rows (org-create-posture-gate, implicit-account-linking, dev-admin-seed-credential-gate)
body:
Fixes #23184
Clause-②: no

The three `@objectstack/plugin-auth` rows that were still open on #23184. Every other row on the card has landed (#23243, #23300, #23697, #23711, #23721, #23748), so this PR closes the card. Tests only: no source file, option or export changes, and nothing is published (`skip-changeset`).

## The readings (A1)

Each reading is the vitest module line (`✓ src/FILE.test.ts (N tests) MS`), the number the hourly battery's per-file timing reads. Base and head ran interleaved, three rounds, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, on a shared box. Base is the file at `de4352460`, run under a temporary name. Head is `6c63f499e` (the merge of `main` after it touches none of these files).

| file | base runs (ms) | head runs (ms) | median base → head | card CI reading → projected |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `org-create-posture-gate.test.ts` | 4756 / 4856 / 4317 | 1309 / 1175 / 1112 | 4756 → 1175 (−75 %) | 11.6 s → 2.9 s |
| `implicit-account-linking.test.ts` | 3365 / 3538 / 3449 | 1051 / 1324 / 1288 | 3449 → 1288 (−63 %) | 11.7 s → 4.4 s |
| `dev-admin-seed-credential-gate.test.ts` | 4824 / 4560 / 4504 | 2741 / 2740 / 2753 | 4560 → 2741 (−40 %) | 10.3 s → 6.2 s |

The projection scales the card's CI reading by head ÷ base. That is the card's own worst CI/local ratio applied to the head median (2.44, 3.39 and 2.26). No file declares a budget header: all three come in under the 10 s line.

**Where the time went (per-case probe at base, scrypt calls counted and timed):**
- `org-create-posture-gate`: the slowest phase was per-test. 25 sign-ups each ran one production-parameter scrypt derivation under a fresh salt, 3.5 s of 4.9 s. The first case also loaded better-auth's vendor modules inside the clock, about 0.8 s.
- `implicit-account-linking`: also per-test. 14 sign-ups took 1.9 s of 3.8 s, and the first manager's vendor load took about 0.75 s.
- `dev-admin-seed-credential-gate`: per-test again. A sqlite boot (`init()` plus DDL for 30 objects, about 70 ms) ran in each of 15 cases. There were 12 derivations (1.8 s), and case ⓪ paid about 1.1 s of vendor load.

**CI readings (A2): NOT MEASURED.** Two sources were tried. The `test-core-timings-K-of-6` artifacts of the hourly runs (latest `39265242003`) and the Test Core job logs both redirect to `productionresultssa13.blob.core.windows.net`, which answers 403 from this container. The `Test Core` check-run annotations name only the slowest file of a package that is over its ceiling. The open refresh #24467 carries no per-file readings ("Regression readings: NOT MEASURED"). So the card's 2026-10-13 readings stay the CI numbers, and the pin is the next measured refresh's list.

## What changed

- **All three files: vendor modules load at module top.** `AuthManager` reaches better-auth through a lazy `await import()`, so the first case paid the vendor's module evaluation inside its clock. Side-effect imports at module top follow AGENTS.md ("clocked windows measure behaviour, never loading"). They copy the shape `admin-impersonate-endpoint.test.ts` already uses, and each list is the set of modules a probe saw that file's managers load.
  - better-auth's one load-time read is `NODE_ENV`, which its env module keeps on first evaluation. Measured inside vitest: that module is already evaluated when the `./auth-manager` import runs. It is reached via `./objectql-adapter.js` → `better-auth/adapters`. The vendor reads `isTest() = true, isDevelopment() = false`, even after a case sets `NODE_ENV=development`. So moving the rest of the load changes no captured value, and `dev-admin-seed-credential-gate` gets the move too. An earlier note on this card said that could not happen; it does not hold.
- **`org-create-posture-gate`: one founder sign-up per file.** It goes through the real `/sign-up/email` route in a `beforeAll`, with both knobs unset. `runGuidedWorkspaceCreation` copies its tables (`structuredClone`) onto each case's own engine, builds the case's own manager under the case's own env and tenancy service, and presents that sign-up's cookie. No case is about the sign-up: each one is about what `organization/create` and `/auth/config` answer under a scenario. The two cases that sign up inline still do. Derivations: 25 → 3.
- **`implicit-account-linking`: one sign-up per file, copied per case.** `signUp` gives a case's first sign-up on a still-empty engine a copy of one real sign-up's tables, with the user row's address set to the case's own, and answers that sign-up's cookies. Two kinds of sign-up still run live, as before:
  - one on an engine that already holds a user;
  - one under a `secondaryStorage` manager, where the session goes to the cache.

  `makeManager` records which engine a manager runs over. Derivations: 14 → 2.
- **`dev-admin-seed-credential-gate`: pooled engine, scrypt memo.** It reuses the landed `__tests__/sqlite-engine-pool.testkit.ts`: one booted engine per file, emptied before each case, refused if its schema changed or it holds an organization row. It also reuses `__tests__/scrypt-memo.testkit.ts`: a sign-in after the seed, and the second seed run, re-derive the same password against the same salt and are answered from the first derivation's bytes. Every fresh salt is still derived for real. Derivations: 12 → 9. Engine boots: 15 → 1.

Every `it`, `describe` and `expect` line of the base files is present unchanged in the head, compared line by line:

| file | `expect(` lines | `it(` lines | `describe(` lines |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| org-create | 53/53 | 13/13 | 3/3 |
| implicit | 83/83, plus one | 23/23 | 3/3 |
| dev-admin | 50/50 | 15/15 | 1/1 |

The one added `expect` asserts the shared sign-up's own 200, the same check `signUp` already made. In org-create, `expect(cookie).not.toBe('')` is the same line; it now reads the copied sign-up's cookie. The test lists match too: 25/25, 23/23 and 15/15 pass at both base and head.

## Equivalence and isolation (measured once, nothing kept)

- **Equivalence probe** (a temporary test file, deleted, never committed). For every arrangement the head copies, it compared a live sign-up (the base arrangement) with the copy (the head arrangement), normalising ids, tokens, hashes and timestamps.
  - `implicit-account-linking`: all 13 addresses, including the `accountLinking` opt-out manager. The copied tables equal a live sign-up of that address on that manager, and `get-session` with the copied cookie answers 200 for that user and address.
  - `org-create-posture-gate`: all 23 scenarios `runGuidedWorkspaceCreation` runs. A sign-up under the scenario's own env and tenancy service gives the same tables before `organization/create`, then the same status, body, three `/auth/config` flags and tables after it.
  - 36 of 36 equal. No copied row carries a fake-engine sequence id (`row_N`): 0 in all 36. So a copied table cannot collide with an id the case's engine assigns later.
- **Leak mutations**, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob changed, restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - Dropping `structuredClone` in `implicit-account-linking` turns the file red: 12 failed / 23.
  - Disabling the pool's row reset in `sqlite-engine-pool.testkit.ts` turns `dev-admin-seed-credential-gate` red: 13 failed / 15.
  - Dropping `structuredClone` in `org-create-posture-gate` leaves the file green (25/25). Its assertions read `sys_organization`, which each case's own engine creates, so a leak into the sign-up's tables is invisible to them. So isolation there was measured directly. A snapshot of the shared sign-up's tables taken after the `beforeAll` is byte-identical after the last case with the copy, 4 rows before and after. Without the copy the snapshot changes: 4 → 15 rows. The same snapshot in `implicit-account-linking` is identical with the copy and changed without it.
- **Shuffled order:** `--sequence.shuffle` with seeds 1, 2 and 3, all three files green (25/25, 23/23, 15/15). The verbose order shows different first cases per seed.

## Tests and gates, at head `54067dc35` (after merging `main` at `5a871e4e4`)

- **The three files at the final head**, one more interleaved run on the module line: org-create 1274 ms, implicit 1234 ms, dev-admin 2492 ms. Results: 25/25, 23/23 and 15/15.
- **Whole package:** all 165 `@objectstack/plugin-auth` test files ran in 8 chunks with `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, each under the lock. Every chunk exited 0 (`VERDICT command-exit 0`): 165/165 files passed, with 3165 tests passed and 10 skipped. The skips were already there at base.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth run typecheck` gave `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `check:test-typecheck` reports OK and the debt ledger is unchanged (10 files / 88 errors / 23 signatures). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists all three files, and none of them is in the ledger.
- **ESLint** on the three files (`--no-inline-config`): exit 0, no findings.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, at `54067dc35` gave 55 commands. All 55 exited 0, each exit captured before any pipe. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, no workspace `dist/`). It exited 0 when re-run after a full `turbo run build` (77/77, `VERDICT command-exit 0`). `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 55 derived, 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- **CI families** run on this PR's check-runs. `test:repo` was not run locally (CI-owned; the diff touches no repo-project test).
- **No budget header was added**, so `measure-test-shard-timings --self-test` is not owed.

## Acceptance notes

- `org-create-posture-gate`'s assertions cannot see a write that leaks into tables its cases do not read. The copy holds by construction and by the snapshot above. This is an observation about the file's reach, not a defect.
- Each of these files spends about 30 to 35 s in vitest transform and import on this box before its first case, at base and at head. That is outside the module line the budget reads.
